la puente City Council

15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
August 28, 2007
07:00 PM
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
COMMISSIONERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS

PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION PROCLAIMING SEPTEMBER AS NATIONAL ALCOHOL AND DRUG ADDICTION RECOVERY MONTH
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO MARISSA CARRILLO CITY OF LA PUENTE EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Redevelopment Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION TO SELF-CERTIFY COMPLIANCE WITH THE 2004 LOS ANGELES COUNTY CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM GUIDELINES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony, close the public hearing; and (2) adopt the Resolution certifying that the City is in compliance with the 2004 Congestion Management Program (CMP), adopting the 2007 CMP Local Implementation Report and directing the City Clerk to forward a certified copy of said Resolution to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority.
B-2
EXTENSION OF ORDINANCE NO. 06-856 EXTENDING THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 06-853 PROHIBITING ESTABLISHMENT OR OPERATION OF "SMOKE SHOPS" IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony and close public hearing; (3) read the Ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce the Ordinance extending the moratorium on "smoke shops" for an additional one (1) year.
B-3
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING CERTAIN ENERGY CONSERVATION/MODERNIZATION MEASURES AND AUTHORIZING THE EXCLUSION OF SERVICE CONTRACTS WITH CHEVRON ENERGY SOLUTIONS COMPANY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take oral testimony and close the public hearing; (3) adopt the resolution authorizing the Mayor to enter into an Energy Services Contract with Chevron Energy Solutions to perform Design/Renovation of the La Puente Community Center and the Design/Construction of the La Puente Youth Learning Activity Center with an emphasis on energy efficiency and renewal/sustainable building materials; and (4) authorize the Mayor to sign the Municipal Loan Lease Purchase Agreement once the loan has been structured.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF CONTINUING TO UTILIZE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR ANIMAL CONTROL SERVICES ON A MONTH-TO-MONTH BASIS
It is recommended that the City Council approve allowing Los Angeles County Animal Care and Control to continue to provide animal control services on a month-to-month basis and direct Staff to continue to seek other agencies/organizations that may wish to submit a proposal to provide animal care and control services to the City.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1209 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM (D97301-08)-FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
The Screening Committee recommends that the City Council approve the allocations and authorize the Assistant City Manager to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $56,000.
D-3
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
D-4
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
D-5
APPROVAL TO CIRCULATE REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) TO UPDATE THE HOUSING ELEMENT AND ZONING ORDINANCE
It is recommended that the City Council direct Staff to circulate the Request for Proposal.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF QUARTERLY CRIME REPORT PRESENTED BY CAPTAIN MICHAEL SMITH, INDUSTRY STATION
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report as presented
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF PARK AND RECREATION COMMISSIONERS
It is recommended that the City Council vote for five (5) candidates for the Parks and Recreation Commission. Candidates must receive at least three (3) votes to be appointed.
E-3
APPROVAL TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE HACIENDA BOULEVARD AND ELLIOTT AVENUE INTERSECTION MODIFICATIONS AND NEW TRAFFIC SIGNAL AT AMAR ROAD AND ELLIOTT AVENUE PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the plans and specifications; and (2) authorize Staff to solicit bids for the Hacienda Boulevard and Elliot Avenue Intersection modifications and new traffic signal at Amar Road and Elliot Avenue Project.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF RE-ESTABLISHING THE LA PUENTE EDUCATION COMMISSION FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08 AND MAKING APPOINTMENTS TO THE COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt the resolution re-establishing the La Puente Education Commission for one year; and (2) each Council Member either reappoint his/her current appointee, or appoint another individual as his/her representative to the Commission.
E-5
REQUEST TO CONSTRUCT A MONUMENT IN HONOR OF ALL LOCAL VETERANS FROM EVERY BRANCH OF THE SERVICE ON THE TRIANGLE PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE ENTRANCE OF CENTRAL AVENUE AND ABBEY STREET (Requested by Councilmember Solis)
None.

ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 503. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
* Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727, effective September 7, 1995.)
